# miniaudio 0.11.23

Vendored unchanged from https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio/tree/0.11.23.
The license is embedded at the end of `miniaudio.h` (public domain or MIT-0).
Provides native AudioUnit/ALSA/WASAPI playback and capture, plus MP3/FLAC decoding.
Compile the implementation once in `src/miniaudio.cpp`.
